name: fallback_rm_contact
label: Fallback RM Contact
help_text: The contact whose details are shown in the RM card when the logged-in member has no Relationship Manager associated. Defaults to the Client Success Team contact — edit that record in HubSpot to update the fallback display, or pick a different contact here to override.

name: breadcrumb
label: Breadcrumb
help_text: Navigation breadcrumb displayed above the service detail.

children.name: parent_label
children.label: Parent Link Label
children.help_text: Text for the parent page link (e.g. 'Services')

children.name: parent_url
children.label: Parent Link URL
children.help_text: Where the breadcrumb link goes. Defaults to the Services Catalogue page. Override to point elsewhere if needed.

name: heading_level
label: Heading Level
help_text: Controls the HTML heading tag for the service title. Default H1 — this is typically the main page title on a service detail page.

name: whats_included_heading
label: What's Included Heading
help_text: Section heading shown above the "What's Included" content (the content itself comes from the HubDB row's `included` richtext column).

name: related_services_heading
label: Related Services Heading
help_text: Section heading shown above the related services grid (the cards themselves are pulled from HubDB by matching the current service's category / sub-category).

name: form_card
label: Enquiry Form Card
help_text: Settings for the enquiry form card. The actual HubSpot form is selected automatically from the HubDB row's `form` column — only chrome (heading, meta labels, response, disclaimer) is editable here.

children.name: heading
children.label: Form Heading
children.help_text: Heading above the form (e.g. "Enquire Now").

children.name: service_label
children.label: Meta Label — Service
children.help_text: Label for the service-name row in the form's meta block.

children.name: tier_label
children.label: Meta Label — Tier
children.help_text: Label for the tier row in the form's meta block.

children.name: response_type
children.label: Form Response Type
children.help_text: What happens after the visitor submits the form — show an inline message on the page, or redirect to another URL. (Redirect URL is set in HubSpot's form settings.)

children.name: response_message
children.label: Inline Response Message
children.help_text: Message shown inline after the form is submitted. Only relevant when Response Type is "Inline message".
children.default: Thanks for your enquiry. We will be in touch shortly.

children.name: disclaimer_text
children.label: Form Disclaimer
children.help_text: Disclaimer / small print rendered below the form (richtext).

name: rm_card
label: RM Card (Relationship Manager)
help_text: Relationship Manager card shown in the right column on desktop. Auto-populated from the visiting contact's associated 'contact owner' CRM contact (USER_DEFINED association id 35 — hardcoded in HubL because dynamic pages cannot resolve module-field values at association-lookup time). All fields below act as FALLBACKS used when no association is present or a CRM property is empty.

children.name: section_heading
children.label: Section Heading
children.help_text: Heading shown above the RM card. Leave blank to hide.

children.name: section_subtitle
children.label: Section Subtitle
children.help_text: Intro text shown under the heading. Leave blank to hide.
children.default: If you have any questions, please contact your account manager, or simply send email to info@vipsclub.com.au

children.name: heading_level
children.label: RM Heading Level
children.help_text: HTML heading tag for the section heading. Use H2 (default) — H1 is already owned by the service title above.

children.name: booking_link
children.label: Booking Link
children.help_text: Optional link for scheduling a meeting. Gated by both `Show` AND a non-empty URL.

children.name: show
children.label: Show Booking Link
children.help_text: Toggle to show or hide the booking link in the RM card.

children.name: text
children.label: Booking Link Text
children.help_text: Clickable text for the booking link.

children.name: booking_url
children.label: Booking URL
children.help_text: URL for the booking page (Calendly, HubSpot Meetings, etc.). Leave empty to hide.

children.name: phone
children.label: Phone
children.help_text: Phone contact detail with optional icon.

children.name: icon
children.label: Phone Icon
children.help_text: Upload SVG/PNG OR paste raw SVG. Leave both empty to use the built-in default icon.

children.name: image
children.label: Upload Icon (SVG or PNG)
children.help_text: Upload from Files Manager. SVG preferred.

children.name: svg_code
children.label: Or: Paste SVG Code
children.help_text: Paste raw <svg>...</svg> code. Leave empty if using upload above.

children.name: email
children.label: Email
children.help_text: Email contact detail with optional icon.

children.name: icon
children.label: Email Icon
children.help_text: Upload SVG/PNG OR paste raw SVG. Leave both empty to use the built-in default icon.

children.name: image
children.label: Upload Icon (SVG or PNG)
children.help_text: Upload from Files Manager. SVG preferred.

children.name: svg_code
children.label: Or: Paste SVG Code
children.help_text: Paste raw <svg>...</svg> code. Leave empty if using upload above.

children.name: location
children.label: Location
children.help_text: Location / address detail with optional icon.

children.name: icon
children.label: Location Icon
children.help_text: Upload SVG/PNG OR paste raw SVG. Leave both empty to use the built-in default icon.

children.name: image
children.label: Upload Icon (SVG or PNG)
children.help_text: Upload from Files Manager. SVG preferred.

children.name: svg_code
children.label: Or: Paste SVG Code
children.help_text: Paste raw <svg>...</svg> code. Leave empty if using upload above.

name: show_disclaimer
label: Show Disclaimer Card
help_text: Toggle to show or hide the disclaimer card at the bottom of the left column.

name: disclaimer_body
label: Disclaimer Body
help_text: Body text for the disclaimer. Supports rich text formatting.
default: This service is subject to eligibility requirements and terms and conditions. Please read the relevant product disclosure statement before applying.

name: disclaimer_close_icon
label: Disclaimer Close Icon
help_text: Close/dismiss icon on the disclaimer card. Upload SVG/PNG or paste raw SVG code.

children.name: image
children.label: Upload Icon (SVG or PNG)
children.help_text: Upload from Files Manager. Recommended: 15x15px SVG.

children.name: svg_code
children.label: Or: Paste SVG Code
children.help_text: Paste raw SVG code. A default circle-X close icon is provided — update to match your design.
children.default: <svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 15 15" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><circle cx="7.5" cy="7.5" r="7" stroke="#9e9e9e" stroke-width="1"/><path d="M5 5L10 10M10 5L5 10" stroke="#9e9e9e" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

children.name: background_color
children.label: Background Color
children.help_text: Leave empty to use theme default (#f7f7f7)

children.name: padding_top
children.label: Padding Top (px)
children.help_text: Leave empty to use default spacing

children.name: padding_bottom
children.label: Padding Bottom (px)
children.help_text: Leave empty to use default spacing

children.name: text_color
children.label: Text Color
children.help_text: Override the default text color for this module instance. Leave empty for theme default.

children.name: content_width
children.label: Content Width
children.help_text: Control the maximum width of this module's content.

children.name: hide_on_desktop
children.label: Hide on Desktop
children.help_text: Toggle to hide this module on desktop viewports.
